lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Responsibilities of a Defensive Driver — IPDE Process
prompt: When predicting potential hazards in a residential neighborhood, what must a driver anticipate?

options.text: Children darting between parked cars, opening vehicle doors, and pets running
Sudden seismic ground earthquakes cracking residential concrete pavements
Overhead commercial passenger airplanes performing emergency landing glides
Underground municipal water pipeline valves bursting with boiling fluids
